paragraphs.text: 梁武峰启动动画 a ~3s boot splash plugin for DeepSeek Harness (unofficial)
# dsh-boot-splash
A ~3-second boot splash for **DeepSeek Harness** (DSH): the portrait fades up out of the dark, the w
ordmark rises letter by letter, a flash lands, and the screen hands over to the app.
It is a host-side plugin: it injects a self-contained splash (style + DOM + a small script) into the
app's boot HTML, so the very first paint is the splash — no white flash, no half-rendered UI.

## How it works
DSH serves its web shell through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver`. Every index render fires `webser
ver/index-inject`; plugins push rows (`style`, `html`, `script`) that are rendered into the page bef
plugins push rows (`style`, `html`, `script`) that are rendered into the page before the SPA mounts.
The plugin pushes three rows and registers one static route:
| Row | Content |

| `style` | the whole splash stylesheet |
| `html` (body) | splash DOM: portrait, wordmark, light la

yers |
| `script` (body) | dismiss logic (waits for `#root`, click/Esc to skip, CSS auto-hide fallba

|
| `script` (body) | dismiss logic (waits for `#root`, click/Esc to skip, CSS auto-hide fallback) |
The portrait is served from `/x-boot-splash/portrait.webp` (a route the plugin registers).
Two boot paths are covered:

- **Browser GUI** (`http://127.0.0.1:<port>`) — injections are rendered into every index response.
-
**Desktop window** (`dsh-app://app/`) — the shell serves the raw `dist/index.html`, and receives th
e same injection rows through the boot IPC, applying them before the plugin tree starts.
## Install
Requirements: DSH desktop (tested with 0.2.1-rc.2), Node.js 20+.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The script copies `dsh-boot-splash/` into `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\plugins\boot-splash`
and appends an `insert` entry to `cordis.patch.yml` (with a timestamped backup). Restart DSH — the d
esktop shell captures boot injections once at host start, so a page refresh is not enough.

## Performance
The animation only animates `opacity` and `transform`, which run on the compositor thread. Earlier v
ersions animated `filter: blur()` on 15 letters plus a full-screen brightness filter — that re-raste
rizes on the main thread and stutters exactly while DSH is loading its plugin tree. All blur effects
were replaced with static filters or soft gradients.
## Assets and license

- **Code** — MIT, see LICENSE.
- **Portrait asset** — `梁武峰.png`, `dsh-boot-splash/portrait.webp` and
the derived posters/video are **demo material** and are **not** covered by the MIT license. They co
ntain the likeness of a person. If you fork this and publish, make sure you have the rights to the i

mage, or replace it with your own (`dsh-boot-splash/portrait.webp`, 1600 px wide WebP).
- **Trademar
ks** — “DeepSeek” and “DeepSeek Harness” belong to their owners; the plugin only uses the name to de
scribe what it hooks into.
